The Agent Test

In the agentic era, AI procurement agents scan vendor websites and evaluate fit on behalf of buyers. This lab shows you exactly how an AI agent would assess your product page:

  • Fit Assessment — How would an agent rate you for these requirements?
  • Confidence Analysis — Where did the agent hedge? Why?
  • Gap Identification — What couldn't be evaluated from your content?
  • Specificity Rewrites — Before/after examples of agent-readable claims
  • Documentation Gaps — What should your docs say to back marketing claims?

💡 Why This Matters

When AI agents evaluate vendors, vague claims become "unable to verify." Your positioning must work for two audiences: human buyers who respond to emotion, and AI agents who need verifiable specifics.
